issues.title: PascalCase Enforcement vs SQL standard
issues.why: The spec mandates PascalCase for all field names (e.g., SessionId), but SQLite is case-insensitive by default and many Go drivers/mappers default to snake_case. A mediocre coder might produce inconsistent mapping or fail to use backticks/quotes in queries, leading to runtime errors in strict environments.
issues.fix: Explicitly mandate double-quoting all identifiers in SQL snippets and provide a Go struct-to-DB mapping example using tags (e.g., `db:"SessionId"`).

issues.title: Concurrency/Locking implementation gaps
issues.why: While WAL mode is mentioned, the provided Go code uses a simple `sync.RWMutex` for the map of connections but does not address cross-process locking or how to handle 'database is locked' errors during high-concurrency writes to the same Session DB.
issues.fix: Add a requirement for a retry-loop decorator for write operations and specify the use of 'PRAGMA busy_timeout'.

issues.title: Missing Acceptance Criteria for Reset TTL
issues.why: The 5-minute TTL for the Reset API is a core safety feature, but the provided AC-SDB-000 only checks for 'lifecycle wiring' and 'Casbin points', not the actual expiration logic or cleanup of expired tokens.
issues.fix: Add a specific GWT criterion: 'Given a reset request older than 5 minutes, When confirm is called, Then return 401/410 Expired and do not delete data.'
